describe: The image shows a rifle in side view, with a warm reddish-brown wooden stock along the top and dark charcoal-grey metal receiver, barrel and scope mount beneath. A large dark scope sits on the upper left, with a curved trigger guard and bolt in the middle and a thick cylindrical barrel at the bottom. At the lower right, two small round icons, one black and one red, sit in a small square frame. The background is an opaque blue-grey.
